# Trueline IT

> Done-for-you AI receptionist and Google review requests for trades and contractors, and for salons and clinics. Trades and contractors also get missed-call text-back, quote follow-up, chat-to-text, text-to-pay and contractor websites. Plus AI governance for professional firms. We set it up and run it. Call (647) 360-5774 for trades, contractor and salon services.

## AI governance ladder (forms)
For law firms, accountants and advisors that want to use AI safely, done for you: written AI use policies, checks for unapproved AI tools, Microsoft 365 Copilot setup, and staff training. Set up with PIPEDA in mind. This is guidance and setup, not legal advice. The ladder starts at the $1,000 AI Liability Assessment.
- AI Liability Assessment: $1,000, credited in full toward a retainer if you continue within 90 days. First step of the ladder. https://truelineit.com/fractional-ai-officer#assessment
- Fractional AI Officer: $10,000–25,000/mo. Cancel anytime. No contracts, no cancellation fees. https://truelineit.com/fractional-ai-officer
- AI Governance: $2,500/mo, no setup fee. https://truelineit.com/ai-governance
- AI Support Agent: $2,000 build fee + $500/mo. 30-day money-back guarantee, build fee included. We refund what you've paid us in your first 30 days, in full. https://truelineit.com/ai-support-agent
- Hub: https://truelineit.com/for-law-firms-accountants-and-advisors
